provenance.aux_bus_decision: AUX_DA (pin 6) / AUX_CL (pin 7) — MPU-6050's auxiliary I2C MASTER interface to downstream sensors — DEFERRED, not landed as I2C roles. The existing Signal enum has only I2C_SDA/I2C_SCL (no aux/secondary-bus variant), and PinRole.instance's only recognized values are numeric I2C-bus tokens matched by peripheral_roles.instance_from_net_name's regex (I2C\d) — an ad hoc 'AUX' instance string would never be matched against any net-derived instance (dumpling's own AUX nets are named Net-(U7-AUX_CL)/Net-(U7-AUX_DA), no I2C token), so it would be schema-decorative, not functional protection. Giving AUX_DA/AUX_CL the same Signal.I2C_SDA/SCL role as the primary bus would make _is_fixed_function_i2c() true for their nets too, letting check_i2c_peripheral's net classification and cross-net completeness inference treat the auxiliary (downstream-master) bus as evidence for the primary (slave) bus's SDA/SCL completeness — a false corroboration this part's two logically distinct I2C roles do not actually share. Per SCOPE: 'an honest miss on AUX nets is acceptable; a false SDA-role conviction against AUX_DA is not.' No new vocabulary invented; AUX_DA/AUX_CL are left off this entry entirely, parked for the SPI-vocabulary/bus-topology design discussions.

i2c_note: MPU-6050 is a fixed-function I2C motion sensor (6-axis gyroscope + accelerometer), not an MCU alt-fn mux — SDA/SCL (pins 24/23) are single-purpose silicon pins in I2C-slave mode, function_class=fixed applies to them specifically. AD0 (pin 9) is an I2C address-select strap pin (legal states: tie high or tie low; selects between the two possible 7-bit slave addresses) — zero possible_roles, marked via the strap field (Todo 240) so the capability gates exempt rather than condemn it when strapped onto a bus line; AD0 also serves as SPI SDO on the SPI-capable MPU-6000 variant, but MPU-6050 is the I2C-only part per Nelson's verified table, so no SPI role is asserted here. AUX_DA/AUX_CL (pins 6/7) are DEFERRED — see provenance.aux_bus_decision. Remaining non-I2C pins (VDD, VLOGIC, GND, REGOUT, CPOUT, FSYNC, INT, CLKIN, NC/RESV pads) are deliberately omitted — no bus-adjacent role, no condemnation risk to exempt.
